payload.credit_html: "Garamaudo bauciensis, a new freshwater mosasaurid (Reptilia, Squamata) from the Santonian (Late Cretaceous) of Provence, southeastern France"
payload.description_html: Garamaudo bauciensis, right humerus. Paratype (CD13-PAL.2018.3.1.16), Bouc-Bel-Air - Sousquières (Bouches-du-Rhône Department, Provence, Southeastern France), Santonian. A-J, photographs and interpretative drawings in dorsal (A-B), ventral (C-D), anterior (E-F), posterior (G-H) and proximal (I-J) views. Abbreviations: ect, ectepicondyle; ent, entepicondyle; dpc, deltopectoral crest; ri, ridge; t, tubercle.
